Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to go on adventures in her backyard. One day, she saw a big, hairy bear. She was scared of the bear and wanted to say hello. 

A little girl named Lily came along and said, "Hi, bear! What are you doing?" 

The bear replied, "I want to play with you. I can play hide and seek and I can't find me." 

Lily thought for a moment and said, "I can help you search for my friend. Can you help me search for my friends?"
